Reconciliation method and source cautions
Sources: “FG-HFG Gradation List.xlsx” and “FG Postings.xlsx”.
  • Forest Guard and Head Forest Guard records were matched within each normalized Division and designation first. Titles and “(CG)” annotations were ignored; clear spelling and omitted-middle-name variants were reviewed.
  • Home-district assessment is made at Range level, with Beat-level refinement wherever the Division or Range crosses district boundaries.
  • “Yes” or “No” is used only when both the normalized Home District and the physical posting district are resolved. Every uncertain record begins “TBD +” and states the reason.
  • The detail view shows the mapped Range/Beat district, decision basis, location note, and the level of administrative geography used.
  • All logical posting records are represented. Gradation officers have no reliable Posting Return match and are marked “Present only in Gradation List”.
  • Duration is calculated to 29 Aug 2026 from the Range posting date. For Gradation-only records, Division Date is used as a clearly marked fallback.
  • Two NIL rows and one malformed non-officer row were excluded. The malformed row was used as a continuation correcting the preceding officer’s Beat date, with both source rows retained.
  • Four promoted officers appearing in both Gradation sheets were consolidated. The Gradation source also assigns Employee ID 2007008996 to two different names; both records remain separate and are flagged.
  • Two posting dates later than the snapshot remain visible as source exceptions and are excluded from numeric duration filters.
